title.rendered: Container Offices for Sale in Domlur, Bengaluru

content.rendered:
Looking for a container office in Domlur that is ready for work and built to last? SAMAN Portable manufactures steel container offices at our Gopasandra factory in Bengaluru (560099) and supplies them directly to businesses across Domlur and the wider city. As a direct manufacturer, we build each unit on an MS steel frame, fit it out to your layout, and deliver it ready to use — no middlemen, no resold stock.

Domlur sits close to Old Airport Road, Indiranagar and the central business belt, where space is tight and setup time matters. A container office gives growing teams, project sites and satellite branches a solid, lockable workspace that can be placed on site quickly and moved later if your plans change.

Container Offices for Sale in Domlur

A container office for sale in Domlur is a factory-built steel office unit you own outright, made on an IS 2062 MS frame and finished with insulated wall and roof panels, wiring points, lighting, door and windows. SAMAN Portable builds it at our Bengaluru factory and delivers it to your Domlur site ready to switch on and use.

Container office sizes we supply

We supply three standard footprints. Each can be customised with extra windows, partitions, electrical points, air-conditioning provision and flooring to suit the way your team works.

Size Approx. footprint Typical use
10ft Compact single cabin Site office, security or supervisor cabin, 1–2 people
20ft Standard office unit Small team, branch office, 3–6 people
40ft Large office unit Bigger team, meeting plus work zones, or two stacked units

Units can be placed side by side or stacked to add floor space as your team grows. For the full range and current configurations, see our container office range.

Why buy your container office direct from SAMAN

You buy from the people who actually build the unit. That means honest specifications, real after-sales support and a fair price with no reseller margin.

  • Built to standard: every unit uses an MS steel frame to IS 2062, and SAMAN POS India Private Limited holds ISO 9001:2015 certification.
  • Factory-built in Bengaluru: manufactured at our Gopasandra unit (Bengaluru 560099) and dispatched directly to your Domlur site.
  • Warranty you can rely on: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life.
  • Clear delivery terms: delivery from ₹3,000 with transit of 3–5 days, and returns accepted within 7 days of delivery or installation.
  • Made for your layout: choose partitions, window and door positions, flooring, lighting and air-conditioning provision before we build.

Delivery and installation in Domlur

We deliver across Bengaluru, including Domlur and the neighbouring Old Airport Road, Indiranagar and HAL areas. Once your unit is built and quality-checked at the factory, it is transported on a flat-bed truck and placed on your prepared site. For a single unit, the ground only needs to be level and firm; larger or stacked units may need a simple levelled base, which we will advise on before dispatch. Typical transit is 3–5 days from dispatch.

Get a container office quote in Domlur

Tell us the size you need, how many people will use it and any layout or air-conditioning requirements, and we will share a current price and lead time for your Domlur site. As a direct manufacturer, the quote you get is the price you pay.

Call +91 88616 22859 or use the Send Enquiry form on our website to get a quote. You can also browse specifications and request pricing through our container office range.

FAQs


What sizes of container office can I buy in Domlur?

We supply 10ft, 20ft and 40ft container offices. The 10ft suits one or two people or a site cabin, the 20ft fits a small team, and the 40ft works for larger teams or a combined meeting and work space. Units can be stacked or joined for more area.


How long does delivery to Domlur take?

Once your unit is built and quality-checked at our Bengaluru factory, typical transit to a Domlur site is 3–5 days. Delivery starts from ₹3,000 depending on the unit and access.


Can the container office be customised?

Yes. Before we build, you can choose partitions, the position of doors and windows, flooring, lighting, electrical points and air-conditioning provision so the unit matches how your team works.


What warranty do you provide?

Every unit carries 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.


Do I need a foundation for the unit in Domlur?

For a single unit, a level and firm ground surface is usually enough. Larger or stacked units may need a simple levelled base. We advise you on site preparation before dispatch.


How do I get a price for a container office in Domlur?

Call +91 88616 22859 or use the Send Enquiry form with your size, team size and layout needs, and we will share a current price and lead time. You can also browse our container office range online.

author.description: Aman Dubey is the lead marketing and copywriting expert at Saman Portable, specializing in prefabricated, shipping-container, and modular structures. With over 15 years of industry experience, Aman has helped global clients optimize design, streamline production, and amplify brand visibility through data-driven content and strategic SEO. Under his guidance, Saman Portable has become a trusted name in container office solutions and turnkey prefabricated buildings across India and beyond.
